claim: Total default Elastic throughput for a Regional file system in all other AWS Regions is a maximum read of 20 GiBps and a maximum write (metered) throughput of 1 GiBps.
question: What is the default maximum Elastic throughput of a Regional EFS file system in the other Regions?

qualifiers.scope: per Regional file system, for all connected clients, in all other Regions

evidence.quote: | All other AWS Regions | 20 GiBps | 1 GiBps |
evidence.table_header: | AWS Region | Maximum read throughput | Maximum write throughput (metered throughput) |
